builder_plan.scenario: A self-hosted model uses more compute or memory than your workload can justify.
builder_plan.change: Check for a usable pruned checkpoint and runtime support before attempting model surgery.
builder_plan.baseline: The original unpruned model at the same precision, context, and load.
steps: Locate the paper's implementation and check its license, model support, data needs, and hardware requirements. Stop here if you cannot obtain the required artifacts.
Save a small set of representative product tasks and expected outcomes. Keep evaluation tasks out of any training or tuning, and choose quality and cost limits before running.
Run the baseline and the proposed change on identical inputs. Keep other settings fixed and repeat paired runs to expose variation.
Save per-task outputs, failures, timings, and all usage costs. Review regressions before expanding the test.
builder_plan.measure: Task quality, actual GPU memory, serving throughput, and preparation cost.
builder_plan.decision: Keep the change only if it meets your preselected quality and latency limits and improves the metric you care about after setup and operating costs. Otherwise retain the baseline. This is an exploration plan, not a validated recommendation.

title: Direct Pass@$k$ Optimization for Thought Pruning: Balancing Quality and Diversity in Test-Time Reasoning
summary: Replaces ad-hoc quality-scored or diversity-based pruning of partial reasoning traces in test-time scaling with a single selection criterion that directly maximizes pass@k over the retained candidate pool. Costs include implementing the pool-selection objective and its optimization procedure on top of the existing sampling pipeline, plus added selection latency before continued generation, while total inference cost should still fall relative to running all candidates to completion. Can fail if the estimated continuation-correctness probabilities are miscalibrated for the reader's model or task distribution, if the candidate count is too small for diversity to matter, or if the method's gains do not transfer beyond the eight evaluated open-weight models.
rationale: The approach is implementable on a single GPU with open-weight models and directly targets inference-cost reduction, but its benefit depends on workload-specific calibration and the reader's actual test-time sampling budget, so it warrants a controlled small-scale evaluation before production adoption.

Outperforms existing quality-based and diversity-based pruning strategies on eight open-weight reasoning models, with the largest gains at moderate pool sizes; no quantified factor is stated in the abstract.
